opening.argument: The presentation ties participation in Forsage/BUSD to putting money into 4-4 slots, while promoting dollar profits and a personal millionaire outcome. The speaker says, "then you can start the system from the amount that your pocket gives you on 4-4 slots plus" and claims, "you have a profit in the dollar." He further says he "invested lakhs of rupees and today I have become a millionaire from those lakhs." The promotional screens reinforce that solicitation: one invites viewers to join today and displays prior-earnings claims, while another shows BUSD profit, partner counts, and a joining control. The evidence does not establish actual returns, verified platform affiliation, payment routing, completed transactions, or victim loss.
